info.name: Appointment Booking API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the clinic Appointment Booking API, in the order of a full demo.

HOW TO USE: set the collection variables `baseUrl`, `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` (Collection → Variables), then run the folders top to bottom (or use Run collection). Login requests save `userToken` / `adminToken` automatically; later requests use them.

The test day is 2099-12-31 so running this never touches real availability.
